# 🧑‍💼 AI for your role

What to use first, what to add next, and why, by role. Interactive version: [AI for your role on the website](https://vivekanand30.github.io/ai-atlas/roles.html) · Concepts: [AI Map](AI-MAP.md)

[🎒 High-school student](#student) · [🖥️ Frontend developer](#frontend) · [🎨 UX / UI designer](#ux) · [⚙️ Backend / AI engineer](#aieng) · [🧬 Biotech / life-science researcher](#biotech) · [💼 Non-technical professional](#professional)

<a id="student"></a>
## 🎒 High-school student

*Class 11–12, studying for exams and school projects*

> **Mindset:** Use AI as a tutor, not an answer machine: ask it to explain, quiz you and check your reasoning.

**Start today**

| Use | Type | Why |
|:--|:--|:--|
| **[ChatGPT](https://chatgpt.com/)** | App | Turn on Study mode so it walks you through problems step by step instead of handing you the answer. |
| **[Gemini](https://gemini.google.com/)** | App | Guided Learning breaks a topic into small steps and checks your understanding as you go. |
| **[Claude](https://claude.ai/)** | App | Ask it to explain a concept 'like I'm in class 11', then to quiz you with 5 questions. |

**Level up**

| Use | Type | Why |
|:--|:--|:--|
| **[NotebookLM](https://notebooklm.google/)** | App | Upload your notes and textbook chapters to get flashcards, quizzes and audio summaries based only on your material. |
| **[Perplexity](https://www.perplexity.ai/)** | App | For projects: answers with sources you can open, check and cite. |
| **[Khanmigo](https://www.khanmigo.ai/)** | App | Khan Academy's AI tutor, designed for students and built not to just give answers away. |

**Power user**

| Use | Type | Why |
|:--|:--|:--|
| **[Claude](https://claude.ai/)** | App | Ask it to build a small interactive simulation of a physics or chemistry idea, then play with the variables. |
| **[v0](https://v0.app/)** | App | Turn a school project into a real website by describing it. |

⚠️ **Watch out:** Copy-pasting AI answers into homework skips the learning and is easy for teachers to spot. Never trust a fact, formula or citation until you've checked it.

📖 **Concepts worth knowing:** Large Language Models · Prompting & Context Engineering · Limits, Safety & Security (see the [AI Map](AI-MAP.md))

<a id="frontend"></a>
## 🖥️ Frontend developer

*Building web UIs with React, Vue, Svelte or plain HTML/CSS*

> **Mindset:** Let agents produce the first 80% of the UI, and spend your time on taste, accessibility and edge cases.

**Start today**

| Use | Type | Why |
|:--|:--|:--|
| **[Claude Code](https://claude.com/claude-code)** | Agent | Works across your whole repo: builds components, wires state and runs your tests. |
| **[Cursor](https://cursor.com/)** | Editor | If you prefer staying in an editor: inline completion plus an agent panel. |
| **[Context7](https://context7.com/)** | MCP | Feeds current docs for your exact framework version, so you get fewer outdated APIs. |
| **[Anthropic Skills](https://github.com/anthropics/skills)** | Skill | The frontend-design skill steers the agent away from the generic AI look toward a deliberate design. |

**Level up**

| Use | Type | Why |
|:--|:--|:--|
| **[Figma MCP Server](https://developers.figma.com/docs/figma-mcp-server/)** | MCP | The agent reads real frames, variables and components instead of guessing from a screenshot. |
| **[shadcn/ui](https://ui.shadcn.com/)** | Components | Components that models generate well, and the code lives in your repo. |
| **[Chrome DevTools MCP](https://github.com/ChromeDevTools/chrome-devtools-mcp)** | MCP | The agent can inspect DOM, console, network and performance to fix what it built. |
| **[Responsively App](https://responsively.app/)** | Companion | Check every breakpoint at once before you ship AI-generated layouts. |

**Power user**

| Use | Type | Why |
|:--|:--|:--|
| **[Dembrandt](https://www.dembrandt.com/)** | MCP | Pull an existing brand's tokens into Tailwind or shadcn so new pages match it exactly. |
| **[Dembrandt Skills](https://www.dembrandt.com/skills)** | Skill | Brings WCAG, button-state and type-scale rules into every change the agent makes. |
| **[genjutsu](https://genjutsu.athevon.dev/)** | Skill | Deliberate motion and micro-interactions, with a plan you approve before code. |
| **[Playwright MCP](https://github.com/microsoft/playwright-mcp)** | MCP | Have the agent write and run end-to-end tests against the real browser. |

⚠️ **Watch out:** AI-generated UI often misses focus states, keyboard navigation and contrast. Review accessibility yourself, or with a skill, before merging.

📖 **Concepts worth knowing:** Coding Agents · MCP (Model Context Protocol) · Skills & Plugins (see the [AI Map](AI-MAP.md))

<a id="ux"></a>
## 🎨 UX / UI designer

*Research, flows, visual design and design systems*

> **Mindset:** Use AI to explore more directions and test ideas faster. Judgment, research and taste stay your job.

**Start today**

| Use | Type | Why |
|:--|:--|:--|
| **[Google Stitch](https://stitch.withgoogle.com/)** | App | Generate several UI directions from a prompt or sketch, then export to Figma. |
| **[NotebookLM](https://notebooklm.google/)** | App | Synthesize interview transcripts with citations back to what users actually said. |
| **[Claude](https://claude.ai/)** | App | Draft personas, journey maps and UX copy variants to react to. |

**Level up**

| Use | Type | Why |
|:--|:--|:--|
| **[v0](https://v0.app/)** | App | Turn a flow into a clickable prototype you can test with real users today. |
| **[Figma MCP Server](https://developers.figma.com/docs/figma-mcp-server/)** | MCP | Hand off designs that coding agents implement faithfully, down to variables and components. |
| **[Dembrandt](https://www.dembrandt.com/)** | Tool | Audit a competitor's or client's design system in seconds: colors, type and spacing. |

**Power user**

| Use | Type | Why |
|:--|:--|:--|
| **[Dembrandt Skills](https://www.dembrandt.com/skills)** | Skill | Run Nielsen-heuristic and WCAG 2.2 reviews with an agent that cites the rule it applies. |
| **[Claude Code](https://claude.com/claude-code)** | Agent | Ship small production changes yourself, starting from your own Figma file. |
| **[genjutsu](https://genjutsu.athevon.dev/)** | Skill | Turn motion intentions into an approved interaction plan, then working code. |

⚠️ **Watch out:** Generated screens are not research. Don't paste confidential user data into tools your company hasn't approved.

📖 **Concepts worth knowing:** Multimodal Models · MCP (Model Context Protocol) · Skills & Plugins (see the [AI Map](AI-MAP.md))

<a id="aieng"></a>
## ⚙️ Backend / AI engineer

*Adding AI features to products and services*

> **Mindset:** Start with the simplest thing: one prompt plus evals. Add RAG, tools and agents only when the evals show you need them.

**Start today**

| Use | Type | Why |
|:--|:--|:--|
| **[OpenRouter](https://openrouter.ai/)** | API | Try several models behind one key before you commit to a provider. |
| **[Instructor](https://python.useinstructor.com/)** | Library | Validated, typed output from day one, with no brittle string parsing. |
| **[Langfuse](https://langfuse.com/)** | Platform | Trace every call, its cost and latency from the first prototype. |

**Level up**

| Use | Type | Why |
|:--|:--|:--|
| **[promptfoo](https://www.promptfoo.dev/)** | CLI | Prompt and model regression tests in CI. |
| **[LlamaIndex](https://www.llamaindex.ai/)** | Framework | RAG over your data once prompting alone isn't enough. |
| **[pgvector](https://github.com/pgvector/pgvector)** | Database | Vector search in the Postgres you already run. |
| **[FastMCP](https://gofastmcp.com/)** | MCP | Expose your service to every AI client as an MCP server. |

**Power user**

| Use | Type | Why |
|:--|:--|:--|
| **[LangGraph](https://langchain-ai.github.io/langgraph/)** | Framework | Durable, controllable agents with human approval steps. |
| **[E2B](https://e2b.dev/)** | Infra | Run code your agent writes in an isolated sandbox. |
| **[LiteLLM](https://docs.litellm.ai/)** | Gateway | One gateway with budgets, keys and fallbacks across providers. |
| **[garak](https://garak.ai/)** | Security | Scan for prompt injection and jailbreaks before launch. |

⚠️ **Watch out:** Without evals you can't tell whether a change helped. Treat all retrieved content and tool output as untrusted input.

📖 **Concepts worth knowing:** Tool Calling & Structured Output · RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) · Evals · AI Agents (see the [AI Map](AI-MAP.md))

<a id="biotech"></a>
## 🧬 Biotech / life-science researcher

*Wet lab, computational biology or drug discovery*

> **Mindset:** General assistants for reading and writing, domain models for structures, coding agents for analysis. Verify everything against primary data.

**Start today**

| Use | Type | Why |
|:--|:--|:--|
| **[Elicit](https://elicit.com/)** | App | Literature reviews that search papers and extract methods, results and sample sizes into a table. |
| **[NotebookLM](https://notebooklm.google/)** | App | Ask questions across the papers you upload, with citations to the exact passage. |
| **[AlphaFold Server](https://alphafoldserver.com/)** | App | Predict protein and complex structures in a browser, free for non-commercial research. |

**Level up**

| Use | Type | Why |
|:--|:--|:--|
| **[Claude for Life Sciences](https://www.anthropic.com/news/claude-for-life-sciences)** | Plugin | Connectors to research tools such as Benchling and PubMed, plus skills for common scientific workflows. |
| **[Jupyter](https://jupyter.org/)** | Tool | Keep analysis reproducible: code, data and figures in one notebook. |
| **[Claude Code](https://claude.com/claude-code)** | Agent | Have an agent write and run your analysis scripts and notebooks, so you review code, not copy-pasted numbers. |

**Power user**

| Use | Type | Why |
|:--|:--|:--|
| **[Boltz](https://github.com/jwohlwend/boltz)** | Model | Open structure and binding-affinity models you can run in-house and use commercially. |
| **[Modal](https://modal.com/)** | Infra | Run Boltz or other models on serverless GPUs without managing a cluster. |
| **[Model Context Protocol](https://modelcontextprotocol.io/)** | MCP | Connect your lab's databases or ELN to agents through a custom MCP server. |

⚠️ **Watch out:** Never paste unpublished or patient data into consumer chat apps. Treat AI summaries of papers as leads, not facts, and check the figure or table yourself.

📖 **Concepts worth knowing:** Large Language Models · RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) · MCP (Model Context Protocol) · Limits, Safety & Security (see the [AI Map](AI-MAP.md))

<a id="professional"></a>
## 💼 Non-technical professional

*Product, marketing, operations, HR or finance*

> **Mindset:** Automate the repetitive parts of your week, and keep people on the decisions.

**Start today**

| Use | Type | Why |
|:--|:--|:--|
| **[Claude](https://claude.ai/)** | App | Draft documents, analyze spreadsheets and summarize long threads. |
| **[ChatGPT](https://chatgpt.com/)** | App | Brainstorm, rewrite and use voice mode for thinking out loud. |
| **[Perplexity](https://www.perplexity.ai/)** | App | Quick market and competitor research with sources. |

**Level up**

| Use | Type | Why |
|:--|:--|:--|
| **[NotebookLM](https://notebooklm.google/)** | App | Turn policy docs and reports into a Q&A notebook for your team. |
| **[Anthropic Skills](https://github.com/anthropics/skills)** | Skill | The docx, xlsx and pptx skills produce real, formatted Office files, not just text. |
| **[n8n](https://n8n.io/)** | Automation | Connect AI to Gmail, Slack and Sheets to automate recurring workflows. |

**Power user**

| Use | Type | Why |
|:--|:--|:--|
| **[Dify](https://dify.ai/)** | Platform | Build an internal chatbot over your team's documents, with no code. |
| **[Lovable](https://lovable.dev/)** | App | Prototype the internal tool you've always wanted, by describing it. |

⚠️ **Watch out:** Don't automate decisions that affect people without review. Don't connect AI to accounts with more access than the task needs.

📖 **Concepts worth knowing:** Large Language Models · Prompting & Context Engineering · AI Agents · Limits, Safety & Security (see the [AI Map](AI-MAP.md))
